reason: This is a small-surface but high-blast-radius change: it removes a user-visible transaction/session variable in the central sysvar registry (`pkg/sessionctx/vardef/tidb_vars.go`, `pkg/sessionctx/variable/sysvar.go`) and also touches `pkg/server/server.go` plus txn/expression/DDL coverage. `txn_scope` is tied to session/transaction behavior and compatibility, so mistakes here can create broad runtime regressions despite the limited file count.
